questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Sustainable cities require connected social and environmental planning.
options: Sustainable cities require connected social and environmental planning.
An efficient building is equally accessible to everyone.
A neighbourhood project cannot affect other areas.
New construction removes the need for maintenance.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Sustainable cities require connected social and environmental planning.

source.en: Integrated planning therefore evaluates environmental benefits together with fairness, affordability, and the ability of residents to shape their city's future.

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT supported by the lesson?

questions.prompt:

More people can _____ comfortably when the route considers different ages and abilities.
options: walk
walks
walked
walking

source.tr: Güzergâh farklı yaş ve becerileri dikkate aldığında daha çok insan rahatça yürüyebilir.

questions.prompt:
What does “because” express in this sentence?
They also examine barriers such as steep slopes or dangerous crossings, because a short distance is not always an easy journey.
options: çünkü; neden bildirir
yalnızca kişinin adını belirtir
fiilin geçmişte tamamlandığını tek başına gösterir
soru sormak için kullanılır
questions.explanation: Bu cümlede “because”: çünkü; neden bildirir. Kısa mesafe her zaman kolay yolculuk olmadığı için dik yokuş veya tehlikeli geçiş gibi engelleri de incelerler.
